description.zh: 要修改的防护场景。更多信息，请参见[CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~)的**DefenseScene**参数。
description.en: The protection scenario to modify. For more information, see the **DefenseScene** parameter in [CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~).
The type of the protection rule.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh:
修改规则对应的防护对象。
> 仅当 **DefenseType** 为 **resource** 时，需要传入该参数。
description.en:
The protected object associated with the rule to modify.
> This parameter is required only when **DefenseType** is set to **resource**.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
防护规则详情，以一系列参数构造的JSON格式转化成字符串。配置时，您需要指定规则ID，并设置要修改的防护规则配置信息。具体包括：

- **id**：Long类型 | 必选 | 规则ID。

- 防护规则配置信息：与**CreateDefenseRule**接口的**Rules**参数相同。相关描述，请参见[CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~)的**防护规则参数描述**。
description.en:
The details of the protection rule. The value is a string that is generated from a series of parameters in JSON format. When you configure this parameter, specify the rule ID and the protection rule configuration to modify. The following parameters are included:

- **id**: Long | Required | The rule ID.

- Protection rule configuration: Same as the **Rules** parameter of the **CreateDefenseRule** operation. For more information, see the **protection rule parameter description** in [CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~).

description.zh:
防护规则模板ID。
> 仅当 **DefenseType** 为 **template** 时，需要传入该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the protection rule template.
> This parameter is required only when **DefenseType** is set to **template**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-defense-rule --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 5325 --defense-scene waf_group --rules id_:_2344,_policyId_:_1012,_action_:_block --defense-type template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --resource rencs000-waf --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyDefenseRule --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --DefenseScene waf_group --Resource 'rencs000-waf' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DefenseType template --Rules 'id_:_2344,_policyId_:_1012,_action_:_block' --TemplateId 5325
